description: This file defines the DateHelper class with static methods for handling Gregorian calendar date values, including month and weekday names (translated and untranslated), date ranges, and date component arrays.

classes.name: DateHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date-related data, including month and weekday names, date ranges, and date component arrays, tailored for the Gregorian calendar system within Drupal.

methods.name: monthNamesUntranslated
methods.description: Returns an array of month names in English, keyed by month number.

methods.name: monthNamesAbbrUntranslated
methods.description: Returns an array of abbreviated month names in English, keyed by month number.

methods.name: monthNames
methods.description: Returns an array of translated month names, optionally including a blank entry based on the $required parameter.

methods.name: monthNamesAbbr
methods.description: Returns an array of translated abbreviated month names, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: weekDaysUntranslated
methods.description: Returns an array of week day names in English.

methods.name: weekDays
methods.description: Returns an array of translated week day names, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: weekDaysAbbr
methods.description: Returns an array of translated week day abbreviations, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: weekDaysAbbr2
methods.description: Returns an array of 2-letter translated week day abbreviations, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: weekDaysAbbr1
methods.description: Returns an array of 1-letter translated week day abbreviations, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: weekDaysOrdered
methods.description: Reorders an array of weekdays to match the first day of the week as configured in system settings.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Returns an array of years within a specified range, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Returns an array of days for a given month and year, defaulting to 31 days if not specified.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Returns an array of hours formatted according to the specified format, defaulting to 24-hour format.

methods.name: minutes
methods.description: Returns an array of minutes, with optional formatting and increment steps.

methods.name: seconds
methods.description: Returns an array of seconds, with optional formatting and increment steps.

methods.name: ampm
methods.description: Returns an array of 'am' and 'pm' options, optionally including a blank entry.

methods.name: daysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the month for a given date.

methods.name: daysInYear
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the year for a given date.

methods.name: dayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of the week as a number (0=Sunday) for a given date.

methods.name: dayOfWeekName
methods.description: Returns the translated name of the day of the week for a given date, optionally abbreviated.
